dependent_variable.name: XRET_{t+1}
dependent_variable.definition: First-year excess return for firm i after the investment date. The printed construction compounds twelve monthly gross returns for the firm and subtracts twelve-month compounded gross returns for its matched Size–BVE/MVE benchmark portfolio. The investment date is the first day of the fifth month after fiscal year-end; for Equation (1), footnote 16 aligns the t+1 return interval with the fifth month of fiscal year t+1 through the fourth month of fiscal year t+2. Benchmark portfolios are value-weighted and formed on market capitalization and book-to-market, with adjusted book value including net imputed R&D assets.
dependent_variable.formula: XRET_{i,t+1} = ∏_{k=1}^{12}(1+R_{ik}) − ∏_{k=1}^{12}(1+R_{pk}); R_{ik} is firm i’s monthly raw cum-dividend return and R_{pk} is the matched benchmark portfolio’s monthly return.

independent_variables.definition: Within-year normalized five-group rank of ΔRDA_{t+1}: observations are sorted from highest to lowest ΔRDA, assigned group labels 0 through 4, and the group rank is divided by four. sample_extraction.data_section_full_text:
2.1. The Sample


This study is based on firms in the Compustat PST, full coverage, and merged research
annual databases for any year from 1979 to 1998. We identified 89,419 firm-years that
satisfied a minimal set of Compustat data requirements. <sup>3</sup> This “main” sample includes
13,442 firms distributed across 73 two-digit (442 four-digit) SIC codes. As we explain
below, some of our analyses are based on analysts’ earnings forecasts from the I/B/E/S
database, and these data are not widely available prior to 1984. These analyses are conducted
using a “reduced” sample that consists of the 72,317 firm-years in our main sample from
the period 1984–1998.
